name: Kaiserstub'n
beschreibung: Kaiserstub'n welcomes guests right in the center of Söll on the Wilder Kaiser, only a short walk from the gondola lift station. The inn combines authentic Tyrolean warmth with a cozy, inviting ambiance. Alpine-style guest rooms offer comfortable furnishings for a restorative stay in the mountains. In the traditional wood-paneled dining parlors, the kitchen serves classic Tyrolean recipes and seasonal specialties made from locally sourced farm ingredients. Its village-center setting ensures immediate access to the expansive SkiWelt Wilder Kaiser-Brixental slopes as well as scenic summer hiking trails.
kurzbeschreibung: Traditional alpine inn in the heart of Söll on the Wilder Kaiser featuring cozy wood parlors and regional dining.
